name: The Mandalorian Wars begin
summary: Mandalore the Ultimate's rebuilt Neo-Crusaders began conquering independent worlds beyond the Republic's north-eastern frontier, testing the Republic's resolve for a decade before striking it directly. The Jedi Council insisted the true threat lay elsewhere and refused to intervene.

name: Battle of Cathar
summary: The Neo-Crusaders under Cassus Fett drove the Cathar into the sea and slaughtered them from the air, killing nine in ten of the species. The Mandalorians kept the massacre secret; its discovery a decade later turned Revan's followers into a crusade.

name: Mandalorian conquests beyond the Republic frontier

location.note: Althir, the Tingel Arm and other independent worlds

summary: For eleven years the Neo-Crusaders absorbed the independent worlds along the Republic's edge, Althir among them, forging conquered peoples into new Mandalorian clans. Each victory brought them closer to the Republic's borders and taught them how it would fight.

name: The Padawan Massacre of Taris
summary: Convinced by a vision that one of their students would become a Sith, the Jedi Covenant masters on Taris murdered their own padawans on the night of their knighting. The one who escaped, Zayne Carrick, was framed for the crime.

name: The Jedi Council refuses to join the war
summary: As the Republic's calls for help grew louder, the High Council ruled that the Jedi would wait and watch, sensing a darker threat behind the Mandalorians. Younger Jedi saw only cowardice while worlds burned.

name: Revan rallies the Revanchists
summary: A charismatic young Jedi Knight who would later be known as Revan began touring the Order's enclaves, arguing that the Jedi had a duty to defend the Republic. His followers, called Revanchists, included his closest friend Alek, the future Malak.

name: The Mandalorians invade the Republic at Onderon and Dxun
summary: The true war opened with simultaneous strikes on the Republic's north-eastern worlds. Onderon held, but the Mandalorians took Dxun and made the moon a forward base for the whole war, while a second thrust drove at Taris.

name: Battles of Suurja
summary: Four indecisive battles on the farm world Suurja were the Republic's first real test against the Neo-Crusaders. The line held just long enough for the Republic to believe it could win without the Jedi.

name: Battle of Vanquo
summary: The Mandalorians broke the Republic's forward line at the mining world Vanquo, opening the road to Taris. The defeat exposed how badly the Republic Navy had underestimated the clans.

name: Siege and fall of Taris
summary: The Neo-Crusaders besieged the great city-world Taris and took it after the Republic fleet withdrew to protect the Core. Taris spent years under Mandalorian rule before Revan's counteroffensive freed it.

name: Raid on Flashpoint Station

location.note: Flashpoint Station, deep in Mandalorian-held space

summary: Captured Jedi were taken to a research station where the scientist Demagol vivisected them to learn the secret of the Force. Zayne Carrick's band freed the prisoners and exposed the experiments.

name: Nuclear bombardment of Serroco
summary: Admiral Karath's fleet sheltered among Serroco's cities, assuming the Mandalorians would honour the customs of war. Mandalore answered with nuclear missiles that erased the cities and most of the fleet in minutes.

name: Rakghoul outbreak and destruction on Jebble
summary: A Sith-made rakghoul plague tore through the Mandalorian army massing on the ice world Jebble. Cassus Fett bombed the planet from orbit to contain it, killing his own troops along with the infected.

name: Battle of Duro
summary: The Mandalorians struck the Core shipyards of Duro and smashed the Republic fleet defending them, proving they could hit the heart of the Republic at will. The Senate's confidence in a quick victory collapsed with the fleet.

name: The Revanchists uncover the Cathar massacre
summary: Searching Cathar for proof of Mandalorian atrocities, Revan's followers witnessed a Force vision of the massacre and found the mask of a Mandalorian who had died protesting it. Revan put the mask on and vowed to wear it until the clans were broken.

name: Revan and Malak lead the Jedi into the war
summary: With the Cathar evidence in hand, Revan openly defied the Council and brought a third of the Order's Knights into the Republic's armies. The Council disavowed them but did not stop them.

name: The Mandalorians break through toward the Core

location.note: the Core approaches along the Hydian Way

summary: Speculative. Without Revan's generalship the Republic's defeats at Duro and Serroco would have continued; Mandalore's forces would have pushed down the Hydian Way toward the Colonies within two years.
basis: Canderous Ordo in Knights of the Old Republic states the Mandalorians were winning until Revan took command, and the Mandalorian Wars article records a string of Republic defeats before the Revanchists joined.

name: Revan is made Supreme Commander of the Republic forces
summary: After a string of victories, the Senate handed Revan command of the entire war effort. He and Malak reorganised the fleet, promoted officers like Saul Karath and Carth Onasi, and began a war of manoeuvre the Mandalorians could not match.

name: Revan's counteroffensive

location.note: Jaga's Cluster, Althir, the Mandalorian-held north

summary: Revan's fleets rolled the Mandalorians back world by world, trading the clans' ferocity for strategy and sacrifice. Battles such as Jaga's Cluster and Althir were won at a cost in lives and Jedi principles that was already beginning to change the Revanchists.

name: The Republic retakes Taris
summary: As part of the counteroffensive the Republic recaptured Taris after years of occupation, though the Mandalorian withdrawal left the city-world battered and its lower levels infested with rakghouls.

name: Battle of Dxun
summary: Republic forces under the Jedi General later called the Exile stormed the Mandalorian base on Dxun in brutal jungle fighting that cost thousands of lives. The victory broke the Mandalorian grip on the Onderon system.

name: Bao-Dur builds the Mass Shadow Generator
summary: The Zabrak engineer Bao-Dur designed a superweapon for Revan that could generate crushing gravitational shadows across an entire battlefield. Revan intended it as the trap that would end the war in a single engagement.

name: Revan discovers Malachor V and the Trayus Academy
summary: Scouting the forbidden Sith world Malachor V, Revan found the Trayus Academy and the first hints of a Sith Empire surviving beyond the Rim. He chose Malachor as the battlefield for his final trap, and its dark side began to work on him.

name: Battle of Malachor V
summary: Revan lured the full Mandalorian fleet to Malachor V and met it with a Republic fleet under the Exile's command. Revan killed Mandalore the Ultimate in single combat as the battle raged in orbit.

name: Revan kills Mandalore the Ultimate
summary: Revan defeated Mandalore the Ultimate and took his mask, learning from the dying warlord that the Sith Emperor had goaded the Mandalorians into the war. Without the mask no new Mandalore could be named, and the clans would scatter.

name: The Mass Shadow Generator is activated
summary: On the Exile's order Bao-Dur triggered the generator. Both fleets were crushed into Malachor's surface and the planet itself cracked apart, killing tens of thousands of Mandalorians and Republic crews in an instant and tearing a wound in the Force.

name: A Mandalorian fleet survives Malachor
summary: Speculative. Without the Mass Shadow Generator the battle would have been decided by conventional fleet action; the Mandalorians would have lost, but a hard core of clans and warships would have escaped to Dxun and Mandalore.
basis: Canderous Ordo describes the clans scattering only after the generator annihilated the fleet; before it fired the battle was a brutal but conventional engagement that Revan's forces were winning.

name: The Exile cuts herself off from the Force
summary: Feeling every death at Malachor through the Force, the Jedi General Meetra Surik unconsciously severed her own connection to it to survive the echo. She became a wound in the Force herself, a living hole the Sith would later covet.

name: A survivor of Malachor becomes Darth Nihilus
summary: One survivor of the catastrophe was left with an endless hunger for the Force itself. Taught by Darth Traya, he became Darth Nihilus, a wound in the Force that fed on whole worlds.

name: The Mandalorians surrender; the clans are disarmed
summary: Leaderless and fleetless, the surviving clans surrendered. Revan ordered them stripped of their armour and weapons and scattered, and took Mandalore's mask with him so no one could rally them again.

name: The Jedi Council exiles the General
summary: The only Revanchist to return and face the Council, the General was stripped of her title and cast out of the Order for her part in Malachor. The Masters could not feel the Force in her and feared what that meant.

name: Revan and Malak lead the fleet into the Unknown Regions
summary: Claiming to hunt the last Mandalorian holdouts, Revan and Malak took the best of the Republic fleet past the edge of the map. They were following the trail of the Sith influence Revan had sensed behind the war.

name: Revan and Malak are enslaved by the Sith Emperor
summary: The two Jedi found the hidden Sith Empire on Dromund Kaas and confronted its Emperor, who broke their minds and bound them to his will. He sent them back to find the Star Forge and soften the Republic for his coming invasion.

name: Revan and Malak find the Star Forge
summary: Following the Rakatan Star Maps from Dantooine through Kashyyyk, Manaan, Tatooine and Korriban, Revan and Malak reached Lehon and the Star Forge. The ancient factory recognised the dark side in them and gave them a fleet.

name: Canderous Ordo takes up Mandalore's mask on Dxun
summary: Given the mask by the redeemed Revan, the veteran Canderous Ordo declared himself Mandalore the Preserver and began gathering the scattered clans at a camp on Dxun. He would aid the Exile against the Sith Triumvirate.
